text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaaaaaahhh!!
I won't lose... I won't lose, daaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nwoooooh, what tenacity...!?
However! HAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is settled! The victor is
TM Opera O. However—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto puts up a ferocious fight!
A reborn, demon-possessed sprint,
she's tearing down the track!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*...
I couldn't... surpass them. But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What was... that feeling just now...?
What is this... feeling...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy... sparkly... and on top of that,
I'm so, so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is this... me when I'm serious?
If I can do my best like this, surely...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I know I can become it!
A truly dazzling version of myself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O...-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why didn't we do this before? Until now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, why do you ask...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I felt it. Today, you showed the fierce spirit of a lion. And the charisma lying deep within you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you could muster such power, you could have
staged a far more magnificent revue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "If you were holding back, there is no need for that going forward. Become a raging surge of waves and come at me!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall defeat that version of you, and conquer
the previous generation in the fallout as well. Sounds good?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee, I'll follow you, Opera O-san.
Wait, that's not it...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I will do my best! As rivals
who push each other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What on earth is this...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The variance in lap time is impossible!
She slightly surpassed... the theoretical absolute value!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A person's capacity... isn't supposed to change. But that guy,
those guys, they went and smashed right through the ceiling that I could never break!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's too close to call.
The previous gen's raw numbers are still higher, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The Three Goddesses... rolled the damn dice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan.
Looks like the Arima Kinen is gonna get interesting!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan... After seeing that race just now...
can you... really say that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm getting even more thrilled than before.
Both Opera O and Doto
have gotten stronger. Does this mean—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It feels great, doesn't it! If we all get hyped up together, I feel like there's no limit to how awesome we can be!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—That's true. You're right.
I'm sorry, that was very unlike me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I cannot stand here shivering with dread.
I must meet it head-on—with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaan!
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I couldn't win today, but I... I...!
choice_data_list: You're just one step away from your dream
You're just one step away from your dream, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Next time... next time I definitely want
to run in the Arima Kinen! On that grand stage...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I will become a sparkling Umamusume!
I'll beat the generation above me and Opera O-san...
to become the sparkliest of them all...!!

Meisho Doto unlocked the door of possibility,
breaking free of her dependence on TM Opera O.

Next up is—the decisive battle at the Arima Kinen.
To seize the brilliance she dreamed of, she must defeat every single Umamusume!
